summary.text: Dave DeFronzo, listed by Ballotpedia as David DeFronzo, is a Democratic and Working Families Party member of the Connecticut House of Representatives from District 26 who took office on January 8, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: DeFronzo won the open House District 26 seat on November 5, 2024, defeating Republican Barbara Marino, 59.8 percent to 40.2 percent, after defeating Aram Ayalon in the August 13, 2024 Democratic primary.
The August 11, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled, and he faces Republican Sal Simsek in the general election.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee, the Education Committee and the Higher Education and Employment Committee.
